scenarios.name: amb_warp_arn02_mac01
scenarios.subject: AMBWARP: the Select menu warp (livewarp, the call pm_warp_live -> warp_end_intro) from Gusty Gulch arn_02 (AMBIENT_WIND MSEQ) to Toad Town mac_01 (no ambient clear). The ambchk line on mac_01 shows whether the wind MSEQ stopped.
scenarios.proves: AMBWARP: warp_end_intro calls play_ambient_sounds(-1, 0), so snd_ambient_is_stopped(0) is AU_RESULT_OK or AU_AMBIENCE_ERROR_3 on the first world frame of mac_01.
scenarios.debug: warp=arn_02:0 story=ch0_toad_town livewarp=300:mac_01:0 ambchk loglevel=debug det

expected_events.name: menu warp ran
expected_events.regex: livewarp: scene frame 300 to mac_01 entry 0

expected_events.name: warp_end_intro ran
expected_events.regex: warp: songs, loop sounds and ambient stopped

scenarios.reason: AMBWARP gate. No shots: the ambchk lines are the gate. Menu warp path (livewarp), not the tour. Cap 45 s.
